title: Streamlit changed the behavior of jupyter_client
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I want to use streamlit to display the image from a code execution result from jupyter_client.

However, I found that importing streamlit will change the msg_type from jupyter_client, from `display_data` to `stream`
So I can't get the image to display.

Looks like that after importing,  streamlit changed the stdout or something similar.
Is this normal?

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
from jupyter_client import KernelManager
import re
import streamlit as st #if you do not import streamlit, the behavior will be normal

def extract_code(text):
    import json5

    # Match triple backtick blocks first
    triple_match = re.search(r'[^\n]*\n(.+?)```', text, re.DOTALL)
    # Match single backtick blocks second
    single_match = re.search(r'`([^`]*)`', text, re.DOTALL)
    if triple_match:
        text = triple_match.group(1)
    elif single_match:
        text = single_match.group(1)
    else:
        try:
            text = json5.loads(text)['code']
        except Exception:
            pass
    # If no code blocks found, return original text
    return text

# start the kernel and manager

km = KernelManager()
km.start_kernel()
kc = km.client()

command = "\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\neven_numbers = list(range(2, 101, 2))\nplt.bar(range(len(even_numbers)), even_numbers)\nplt.xlabel('Even Numbers')\nplt.ylabel('Value')\nplt.title('Even Numbers in the Range 1-100')\nplt.show()```"
command = extract_code(command)
kc.execute(command)
while True:
    msg = kc.get_iopub_msg(timeout=5)
    msg_type = msg['msg_type']
    print(msg_type)
    print(msg)
    if msg_type == 'status':
        if msg['content'].get('execution_state') == 'idle':
            break
```


### Steps To Reproduce

run the above code with streamlit imported
and run it again without streamlit imported
you will see the difference

### Expected Behavior

The msg_type from jupyter_client should be `display_data` and it contains the base64 image
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d2f808f-4629-4a9a-a522-9227d552d0ea)


### Current Behavior

The msg_type from jupyter_client is `stream` and it does not contain the base64 image
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c4e4a37f-9bcf-45ce-bc1f-dd2e88e3685f)


### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.38.0
- Python version: 3.9.19
- Operating System: MacOS 14.6.1
- Browser: Not related


### Additional Information

_No response_

```

https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/d47ec47654990ee199c951bafbd5006d33df2ae5/lib/streamlit/__init__.py#L56
